Chapter 6817: Everlasting Golden Lamp

Chapter 6817: Everlasting Golden Lamp

“Thunder, don’t be so aggressive, I never said I want to keep it.” Ironleaf said.

The atmosphere became tense before the enemies’ arrival. There appeared to be a crack in the alliance already.

“Ancestor, I apologize for my rudeness. Please return the shrine to them.” She admitted fault but still didn’t change her stance.

He snorted in response.

“Okay, old geezer, don’t be so hard on the young ones. We only wanted to take a look, give it back since it’s useless with us anyway.” Six-foot laughed.

When Six-foot was the one to bring this up, Ironleaf couldn’t refuse or his reputation would be ruined. He glanced at the shrine and knew this was special, potentially being at the immortal level or more.

“Take good care of it.” Alas, he gave it back to Li Qiye, albeit unwillingly.

“Don’t worry, no one can take it from me.” Li Qiye smiled.

The city lord heaved a sigh of relief, hoping this was the end of the ordeal.

“Don’t be ignorant, you are only an insect in this vast world.” Blaze Ancestor said.

“I’m just speaking the truth. “Li Qiye shrugged.

Blaze Ancestor gave up on this disobedient brat. How could a mortal be so arrogant?

Anyone else would have been punished. However, if he were to do anything, others would think his eyes were set on the shrine. Thus, he could only grit his teeth and swallow this anger.

“Your shrine is of utmost importance. If it were to be missing, it would be unfavorable to Golden Lamp. If you wish, you may stay with us so we can protect you.” Ironleaf uttered coldly.

“I’m safe here, maybe it’ll be more unsafe to go elsewhere.” Li Qiye waved dismissively.

“You... look like you need a lesson.” Ironleaf said.

“Who will be teaching?” Li Qiye chuckled.

“Hahaha, so courageous.” Ironleaf was going crazy.

The other ancient ancestors stared at this fearless mortal, perplexed. Other cultivators also wanted to teach the mortal a lesson but didn’t wish to break the solidarity.

“Brat, enough arguing. Old geezer, we don’t need to bully a mortal.” Six-foot smiled and calmed the situation.

“Boom!” Suddenly, a massive shadow appeared in space.

“Frenzy City.” This attracted everyone’s attention.

They saw a floating continent with a city built on top, surrounded by layers of storms.

The continent wasn’t overly large and had places for birds and beasts. However, the city occupied more than half of the land.

It used to be known as Storm City before being separated from Golden Lamp due to its progenitor’s fall to darkness.

The city didn’t seem to be descending, only waiting outside.

“Primal Eagle is in there.” Everyone understood.

“It’s afraid of the dao heart.” A big shot said.

In Golden Lamp, overlords would need to face the light of Golden Immortal’s dao heart. Therefore, they preferred not to enter.

“Get ready.” Thunder Emperor ordered her kingdom.

“Our lamp is everlasting, we shall obliterate the enemies.” Six-foot told his race.

“We shall fight as one with the big foots.” Ironleaf said.

“Prepare for battle.” Blaze Ancestor also ordered his sect to join the others.

This was not the first time they needed to rise in arms as one. Thus, they had immaculate teamwork.

“Creak...” The gate of the floating city slowly opened, revealing numerous demons.

They exuded a violent aura like a wild tiger coming across a human village.

“They’re coming!” Cultivators in Golden Lamp assumed the right position and gripped their weapons.

“Boom!” A shockwave erupted and sent them flying. The stronger cultivators channeled their mantra and energy to stabilize.
